svg.title: iOS release and integrity
svg.desc: A platform release is vendored into the app repository at its tag with a sha256 per file; the app’s MARKETING_VERSION must equal that release. make testflight, run from the tag, stages the database for the chosen profile, runs the licence gate on that artifact, generates a temporary Xcode project, archives and uploads, proves the Info.plist and the manifest inside the app, and records the build in the ledger; check_release_complete.py then proves web, API and binary share one version and one commit. On the device, LaunchIntegrity hashes the bundled database against its manifest and refuses to show scripture on a mismatch; bookmarks live in a versioned SwiftData store that is only recreated after a second consecutive failure.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From the platform tag to an App Store binary that carries the same number — every step a gate — and what the app proves to itself before it shows a single line
